key.name: make-primary
key.summary: Make the client’s virtual monitor primary
key.description: When a client connects, make its virtual monitor the primary monitor for as long as it stays connected.

key.name: gather-mode
key.summary: Which windows to move to the client’s virtual monitor
key.description: When a client connects, move the normal windows of all workspaces (“all-workspaces”), of the current workspace only (“current-workspace”), or none (“off”) to its virtual monitor. Every window keeps its workspace while that monitor is primary; on a monitor that is not, GNOME shows it on all workspaces (while org.gnome.mutter workspaces-only-on-primary is on, its default).

key.name: restore-on-disconnect
key.summary: Put windows back when the client disconnects
key.description: When the client disconnects, put each window the extension moved back on the monitor and workspace, with the position, size and state it had before, if that monitor still exists.

key.name: debounce-ms
key.description: The extension acts on monitor changes only after this long without another one. It is also the longest wait for the layout change after making the monitor primary, and the longest wait before trying again when that fails. Not shown in the preferences.

key.name: settle-ms
key.summary: Settle period of the placement record, in milliseconds
key.description: A window's change of placement is recorded only after the window has been still for this long. Not shown in the preferences.

key.name: debug-logging
key.summary: Log each state change, apply and gather
key.description: Add a journal line for each state change, display configuration apply and gather. Warnings and errors are always logged. Not shown in the preferences.
